blocks.text:
Proposed decision
Commission a site-specific grid connection and impact study before choosing a connection arrangement.
Rationale
The 25 MW course reference is a case assumption. It does not establish local grid capacity or effects on other customers.
Evidence

RTE's "fast-track" connection offer requires specific site criteria, including proximity to a 400 kV substation and RTE's capacity to manage congestion without limitations for consumers. ([services-rte.com](https://www.services-rte.com/en/learn-more-about-our-services/connect-an-installation-to-the-public-transmission-network.html?utm_source=openai))


Unknowns
Connection date, upgrades, queues, cost allocation and curtailment remain unconfirmed.

blocks.text:
Proposed decision
Stage funding decisions: demand and site screening first; construction only after a grid offer, permits, bids and member commitments; equipment delivery aligned with power readiness.
Rationale
These are proposed project gates, not lender requirements. An example elsewhere does not justify our investment.
Evidence

The EuroHPC Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC JU) has initiated procurement for the Alice Recoque exascale supercomputer, to be located in France, demonstrating a commitment to national HPC infrastructure development. ([eurohpc-ju.europa.eu](https://www.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/new-call-procure-european-exascale-supercomputer-alice-recoque-2024-09-09_en?utm_source=openai))


Unknowns
Funding terms and risk allocation remain open. Provisionally, the consortium bears delay and unused-capacity risk unless contracts transfer it.
